questions.question: Which 2008 superhero film is usually credited with launching the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.note: The Incredible Hulk followed the same year; the post-credits Nick Fury scene set the table.

questions.question: Which 2017 horror-satire follows a Black man meeting his white girlfriend’s family for the weekend?
questions.note: Jordan Peele’s debut; the sunken place became a cultural shorthand.

questions.question: What 2009 James Cameron film was the first to gross over $2 billion worldwide?
questions.note: Set on Pandora among the Na’vi; sequels followed in the 2020s.

questions.question: Which 2014 Christopher Nolan film follows a team traveling through a wormhole to save humanity?
questions.note: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, and a lot of Hans Zimmer organ.

questions.question: In which Marvel film does Thanos first snap his fingers and wipe out half of all life?
Which 2023 Greta Gerwig film starring Margot Robbie was released the same weekend as Oppenheimer?
questions.note: “Barbenheimer” — pink vs. plutonium as a double feature.

questions.question: What 2000 film stars Tom Hanks as a FedEx employee stranded on an island?
questions.note: Wilson the volleyball is the co-star everyone remembers.

questions.question: Which 2010 drama about the founding of Facebook was directed by David Fincher?
questions.note: Jesse Eisenberg as Mark Zuckerberg; Aaron Sorkin wrote the script.

questions.question: Which 2022 Best Picture winner stars Michelle Yeoh in a story about a multiverse of lives?
questions.note: A24; also won Best Director and Best Actress. EEAAO is just the initials.

questions.question: Who played the title physicist in Christopher Nolan’s Oppenheimer (2023)?
questions.note: Murphy won Best Actor; RDJ won Supporting Actor as Lewis Strauss.
